newsitem.title: USA: Cox to receive 20.7 mln shrs in Flextech.
newsitem.headline: Cox to receive 20.7 mln shrs in Flextech.

text.p: Cox Communications Inc said Monday it will exchange its interest in two British cable and satellite television channels for an equity stake in Flextech PLC, a cable programming company.

The company said it would exchange its 35 percent interest in UK Gold and 43.75 percent interest in UK Living for 20.7 million shares in Flextech. The amount of shares represents 12.55 percent of the British company at a value of $250 million, it said.
Cox said it expected to close the deal in about 45 days.
UK Gold is an entertainment channel featuring classic entertainment from the libraries of BBC Enterprises and Thames Television, while UK Living is programming aimed at women.
Cox Communications is a U.S. cable television operator, serving more than 3.2 million customers.
